bullets: Roster & Front Office: San Francisco signed WR Brandin Cooks to the practice squad [49ers Webzone](https://www.49erswebzone.com/articles/205528-shanahan-reacts-brandon-signing-commanders/).

Injury & Practice Status: CB Upton Stout (shoulder, neck), OT Carver Willis (illness), and CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [Matt Maiocco](https://bsky.app/profile/mattmaiocco.bsky.social/post/3n35xyxjr3s2b). WR Jordan Watkins (groin), S Siran Neal (knee, foot), QB Brock Purdy (ankle), and WR Mike Evans (Achilles) did not practice Wednesday [Matt Maiocco](https://bsky.app/profile/mattmaiocco.bsky.social/post/3n35xyxjr3s2b).

Week 12 Seahawks Outlook: Kyle Shanahan and DC Raheem Morris open installation for the Seattle Seahawks (6-4, SF -2.5, HC Mike Macdonald, OC Brian Fleury & DC Aden Durde (Levi's Stadium)) at high altitude in Mexico City—a unit ranked #1 in Yards Allowed / Game (236.1 yds) as San Francisco prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [49ers.com Official](https://www.49ers.com/news/brock-purdy-named-nfc-offensive-player-of-the-week-following-mexico-city-win) [Vic Tafur](https://bsky.app/profile/victafur.bsky.social/post/3n35z3unwis23).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 9-1 (1st in NFC West • #1 Seed in NFC), San Francisco carries a 99.5% postseason projection, 91.4% NFC West division title mark, and 63.8% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [49ers.com Official](https://www.49ers.com/news/brock-purdy-named-nfc-offensive-player-of-the-week-following-mexico-city-win).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, San Francisco ranks #1 in Points / Game (31.6), #8 in Points Allowed / Game (20.6), #9 in Turnover Differential (+5), giving Kyle Shanahan and Raheem Morris a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 1:25 PM PST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Seattle Seahawks [San Francisco 49ers Official](https://x.com/49ers/status/2125679605667545334).
